## Analysis

sol_0045 refutes the seven-matching projection: imposing permutation regularity on the 66-point seed produced no useful descendant and even returned the weaker 473-point fallback, indicating fragile incumbent handling. More broadly, direct optimization of \(C\) has repeatedly stalled at sol_0036 across unrestricted, fringe, gap, copy, and tensor neighborhoods. Since \(C\) is highly discrete, improvements may require temporarily worsening the ratio while moving to a different \((|A+A|,|A-A|,|A|)\) tradeoff. The unexplored direction is therefore multiobjective search over sum and difference counts rather than another structural family.
